searchText: Hi, can anyone explain the difference between Eth planned-PoS and Cardano's Ouroboros protocol? Ignoring some of the nitty details on slashing conditions, I don't see how they are fundamentally different You leak a *tiny* bit every missed slots. The more often you miss, the more you leak with each miss. I don't know the formal so I don't know how on/off would affect the leak rate compared to consistently off. I *suspect* it is more acceptable to flicker on/off because at even in the worst case, at least the chain is likely still finalizing (just less regularly). do you have data on which is more decentralized? I think that sounds like speculation? and how do you define decentralization? are there? do you have data on this? In PoW hobbyists need to join mining pools, in PoS they need to join staking pools. Where do you see the difference? "ETH is mineable with gpus still so there are a lot more hobbyists miners than there will be hobbyist validators. Especially in poorer countries " I don't have contacts to ask from pools admins, do you? :P and where to get the same data for eth pos? mining requires gpu ownership and if you mine with your gaming pc, your contribution to the security is next to 0 yeah, and you pay more for electricity for that. So you really shouldn't be doing it Folks, this discord is for *research & development*, please can such discussions be taken elsewhere so as not to reduce the signal-to-noise ratio here? this was in a thread but then <@456226577798135808> moved it back :) cryptodevs discord is probably better venue for the discussion It isn't. It is not related to Ethereum research and development. This is not a general-purpose discord, there are plenty of those out there. Not really though. This stuff has been rehashed time and again (here and on the wider internet) and basically in the past as far as Ethereum is concerned. Feel free to discuss elsewhere though, just not in this highly focused Discord server. **TheMerge transition with Mikhail Kalinin** (Paris, Bellatrix & TTD explained) https://youtu.be/kTcJqThCdns
